user.title: Cork Dork
user.description: Set up Cork Dork. This will create a wine inventory with default cabinet sections. You can customize the layout after setup.

init.title: Cork Dork Options
init.description: To sync your Vivino cellar, paste your cellar page URL and your Vivino session cookie (see the docs: docs/vivino-import.md). The cookie is verified against your cellar when you save.

data.default_wine_type: Default wine type for new entries
data.gemini_api_key: Google Gemini API key (used when provider is Google Gemini)
data.ai_base_url: AI base URL (used when provider is OpenAI-compatible)
data.vivino_session_cookie: Vivino session cookie (from your logged-in browser)
data.vivino_auto_sync: Automatically sync the Vivino cellar twice a day

data_description.ai_base_url: Format: https://host or https://host/your-path — with or without a trailing /v1/chat/completions, either works
data_description.ai_model: Format: the exact model name your provider expects, e.g. gemini-2.5-flash
data_description.vivino_cellar_url: Open your cellar in a browser and copy the address from the address bar. It ends with /cellars/ and your cellar number.
data_description.vivino_mode: Import mirrors your Vivino cellar into Cork Dork and never writes to your Vivino account. Synchronize also pushes bottles you add or drink in Cork Dork back to Vivino — in Import mode, manage your bottle counts in Vivino.

error.ai_provider_incomplete: Base URL, API key, and model are all required for an OpenAI-compatible provider.
error.ai_provider_invalid_auth: The AI API key was rejected by the endpoint.
error.ai_provider_cannot_connect: Could not connect to the AI base URL. Check the address and try again.
error.vivino_invalid_auth: Vivino rejected the session cookie — it may be expired or wrong. Paste a fresh one from your logged-in browser.
error.vivino_cannot_connect: Could not reach Vivino — check your network connection and try again.
error.vivino_incomplete: Enter both the cellar URL and the session cookie, or leave both empty to disable the connection.

options.sync: Synchronize (two-way — pushes your changes back to Vivino)
